name: Daisy Cubes Are Ample
scope: Finite down-set representations of daisy cubes.
statement: Every daisy cube has an ample set-family representation.
proof: Let $D\subseteq2^X$ be a down-set. If $T$ is shattered by $D$, some member of $D$ contains $T$, so downward closure gives $T\in D$. Conversely, every $T\in D$ is strongly shattered because the full face $2^T$ lies in $D$. Thus the shattered and strongly shattered sets both equal $D$.
comments: This records existence of an ample representation; root and coordinate orientations are not canonical.
